items.title_orig: For Gen Z buds. The truth about ‘Grunge.’
items.article_text:
So listen friends, I’m seeing a lot of kids of a certain age getting heavy into like Nirvana and Alice In Chains…
 And that’s all well and good, I’m super glad yall are discovering my caveman music… 
 But I just want to present you guys with some truth and perspective…
 I’ve noticed that the way the history books and documentaries have been presenting that era of music… basically everything in the 80s was what, capitalistic? Vapid? Had lost all meaning?
 And then they tell you that guns and roses, broke out of LA with a hair metal sound but a fresh, gritty, urban perspective… and then nirvana and Pearl Jam and soundgarden and Alice In Chains came along and saved us all with “REAL” and “AUTHENTIC” music… 
 First let’s get some shit straight about the 80s.
